items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 08 October 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure from the Azores to France. Low pressure near Iceland, with a frontal zone affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 at first, soon veering west or southwest, settling west 6 or 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough at first and again later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle clearing Friday morning to showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 6 or 7, veering west or northwest 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally falling moderate in showers.
